items.text: Kwelami icala ngiqaqa umucu wamazwi; kwelakho uyawubutha.
items.q: Is it clear that 'uyawubutha' means you gather up the words?

items.text: Izihlahla ziqala ukukhanya kancane kancane futhi kuba yisikhathi esihle sokuvuselelwa. Izinto zihleleka kahle.
items.q: In spring the trees turn green, as if everything is reborn. Is that clear?

items.text: – Kodwa kudala, izandla zakhe zize zibuhlungu — lezo zinyanga ezintathu lapho wamthatha waya eDenmark, ngaba yisikhathi sini.
items.q: Is it clear this is a warm thank-you for taking Baba to Denmark?

items.text: Ngaphandle kokukhuluma, sonke sasazi ukuthi umugqa ophakathi wenkundla wawufanele ubemelene ngqo nomnyango wampofu wendlu intombazane eyaphuma kuyo.
items.q: Is 'wampofu' right for the yellow door of the girl's house?

items.text: Endlini ekugcineni kwegceke, eduze kwesitovisi, nganginele ngasesidlaleni sami futhi ngangisendleleni yokuthola indlela elula yokuxazulula imibuzwano eminingi yekongkuri yezibalo zezinsiza ngokusebenzisa indawojikeleza yesingite.
items.q: He lies on his stomach solving exam trigonometry with the unit circle. Is that clear?

items.text: Izinwele zayo ezixhafanisayo zifana nezinwele ezingaphakathi kwetashi lami.
items.q: The sheep's curly wool looks like the wool in his mattress. Is that clear?

items.text: Wayehambisa ama-chickpea ngokushesha. Wayethela amaningi esikalini, bese ebuyisela amanye.
items.q: Is 'ama-chickpea' the usual Zulu word for chickpeas?

items.text: – Vwoooo, Baba Baba, uzongithengela lo nodoli omkhulu?
items.q: A toddler asks his dad for a doll. Does it sound like baby talk?
